verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run tsc --noEmit to ensure no type errors. 2. Run bun run vitest --run to ensure tests pass. 3. Run bun run lint to ensure no lint errors.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external npm installs allowed. Use only pre-installed dependencies.
contribution_requirements: Run npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test before committing. No TODOs, no placeholders, no mock services. Feature-based folders.
key_patterns: Data file exports two things: a flat array (e.g. corporateIssuersQuestions) and a modules object (e.g. corporateIssuersModules). Seed function uses seeded PRNG (LCG), checks for existing attempt before writing (idempotent), and is called in useEffect in dashboard-content.tsx, attempts-list-client.tsx, and recent-attempts-section.tsx. Question type has id, questionText, answerChoices[], difficulty, subject, reading, topic, provider, questionSourceFile. AttemptQuestion has confidence as 'High'|'Medium'|'Low'. Each question needs 3 answerChoices with label A/B/C.
directory_structure: src/features/question-bank/data/ for question data, src/features/question-bank/utils/ for seed functions and storage, src/features/question-bank/types/ for types, src/features/dashboard/components/ for dashboard, src/features/question-bank/components/ for attempt views
